correctness.rationale: The new root-row gluing identity follows by deleting the shared row, leaving two block-diagonal matrices; the joined row lies in their direct-sum rowspace iff both components do. Weighted-forest rank equals its support matching number because the forest induced by endpoints of a maximum matching has a unique perfect matching, yielding a nonzero minor in every characteristic. The cyclic parity transfer T and alternating determinant cancellation supply P_n,S_n and the rank-neutral root-row count Q_n=(S_n-q^2 z P_n)/(1-z). The all-nonzero rank defect requires both independent cycle determinants to vanish. Since the incidence algebra radical squares to zero, rank r corresponds to Jordan type (2^r,1^(N-2r)). Independently, symbolic matrix recurrence for n=2,3,4 gives polynomial Q_n; the n=m=2 formula is exactly identical as a polynomial in q,z; direct finite-field Gaussian elimination of all 2^8 and 3^8 edge assignments yielded (1,27,120,108) and (1,128,1824,4608). The general claim rests on the combinatorial proof, not these finite checks.
